properties.notes: Redundant waterworks facility within Tweedmouth with existing infrastructure remaining in situ. Now surplus to NWL requirements and offers opportunity for redevelopment within the urban area. A proposal would require demolition of a disused covered reservoir and the former pumping station prior to redevelopment. A hybrid application was permitted in May 2019 for a total of 10 dwellings (18/01164/OUT). This includes 6 apartments with full consent and a further 4 units in outline. A detailed application will follow for the rest of the scheme in due course. Development yet to commence but forecast for completion with the next 5 years.
